name: Heriot-Watt University Dubai
englishBachelors: All programmes: engineering, construction, business, computer science, psychology, design and fashion — awarding the Scottish Heriot-Watt degree.
note: A Scottish university campus in Dubai Knowledge Park. English-taught courses cover engineering, computing, business, psychology and design.
summary: British campus in Dubai (opened 2005) awarding Heriot-Watt degrees, with about 30 undergraduate programmes in engineering, computing, business, psychology and design.
about: Many Scottish honours degrees take four years from Year 1. Eligible students may enter Year 2 directly. Heriot-Watt’s Go Global programme offers transfers between campuses; check which transfers your degree permits.

ib.text: Year 1: 24 IB Diploma points (3 HL, 3 SL). Computer Science requires HL Mathematics; Mechanical Engineering requires HL Mathematics and Physics. Psychology and International Business name no IB subject.

notes: Year 1: 24 IB Diploma points with three HL and three SL subjects. Psychology and International Business Management do not name a required IB subject. Computer Science requires HL Mathematics; Mechanical Engineering requires HL Mathematics and HL Physics. The course director reviews relevant subject scores; the minimum is not a guarantee.

No standalone IB Course Results rule was confirmed. For Mechanical Engineering, Year 2 entry lists 27 Diploma points with HL Mathematics and HL Physics. Other degrees have their own advanced-entry requirements.

No exact September 2027 closing date was found. The campus calendar schedules welcome week for 6–10 September and teaching from 13 September 2027; these are not application deadlines. Some degrees, including Psychology, also offer January entry.

Apply through the Dubai online portal. The university lists a processing fee of AED 525 including VAT per application, accepts scans initially and says review normally takes 2–6 weeks once the file is complete. It normally gives two weeks to accept an unconditional offer.

English proof: for applicants whose school studies were in a non-English-speaking country, the university lists IB English grade 4 at either SL or HL as recognized school evidence. If you need a test, undergraduate Academic IELTS is 6.0 with at least 5.5 in every band, or Duolingo 120 with at least 110 in each component. The official English requirements page lists the other accepted tests and their scores.

Published September 2027 tuition including VAT: AED 82,264 for Computer Science, AED 78,650 for International Business Management and AED 87,010 for Psychology. The Mechanical Engineering page lists AED 82,264 without a fee year; check before budgeting for September 2027.
The published four-year path starts in Year 1. The three-year option requires separate eligibility for Year 2 entry.
The credited photograph shows the current Knowledge Park campus. Use the university’s official virtual tour to explore the building.

programmes.about: A four-year honours degree balancing theory and practice, from software development to machine learning and data mining.
programmes.overview: In year 1 you build programming and web skills and study logic, discrete mathematics and computer systems. Later years add advanced topics such as machine learning, computational intelligence and data mining. September entry runs on Heriot-Watt semesters, with Go Global transfers to other campuses available.

programmes.about: Four-year Year 1 route in mechanical engineering; the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation lists the degree as active.
programmes.overview: Study how to design and assess mechanical systems. The programme connects engineering mathematics and science with design, manufacturing and energy. The separate three-year Year 2 route lists 27 IB Diploma points with 3 HL and 3 SL, including HL Mathematics and HL Physics. The displayed fee includes VAT; its fee year is not stated.
